verified_sources.source_name: Jotun Middle East - Fenomastic Interior Sheen Standards
verified_sources.key_insights: Specular gloss percentages at 60° and 85° angles: Matte (0-5%), Eggshell/Silk/Quarter-sheen (10-25%), Semi-Gloss (30-50%), High-Gloss (70%+). Scrub resistance and pigment-to-binder ratios.

verified_sources.source_name: Caparol Arabia Technical Handbook - Light Reflection & Sheen Selection
verified_sources.key_insights: Impact of direct sunlight vs hidden spot lighting on wall defects. How matte conceals undulations in plaster vs high sheen magnifying imperfections.

verified_sources.source_name: Kuwait Interior Contracting Best Practices Ledger
verified_sources.key_insights: Local family lifestyle patterns: Living halls and corridors require high washability (Quarter/Silk), ceilings require dead matte to hide gypsum joints, master bedrooms favor luxury matte (Fenomastic Wonderwall Lux or Rich Matt).
